highlights: Applied supervised and unsupervised machine learning techniques on real-world datasets for model training and evaluation.
Improved model prediction accuracy by ~15% through feature engineering and hyperparameter tuning using Python and AWS SageMaker.

projects.name: JobSync
projects.tagline: AI Resume Screening & Job Matching Platform
highlights: Built a screening tool that ranks multiple candidate resumes against a pasted job description, returning a fit score, matched and missing skills, and a written verdict per candidate.
Used Pydantic schemas with JSON-mode prompting on Groq so the model always returns typed, validated fields instead of free-form text.
Parsed resumes in PDF and DOCX with pypdf and python-docx, isolating failures per file and adding retry with backoff so one bad file doesn't break a batch run.
Built a Streamlit dashboard with dark and light theming, session analytics, and an exportable print-ready report.

projects.name: IPL Data Analysis & Visualization
projects.tagline: Exploratory data analysis on IPL match and ball-by-ball data
highlights: Cleaned and merged 756 IPL matches and 179,000+ ball-by-ball records (2008-2019), handling missing values and standardizing team names across seasons.
Used the IQR method to flag outliers, then found patterns in top scorers, wicket-takers, and team scoring across overs.
Built 10+ visualizations in Seaborn and Plotly covering powerplay and death-over trends, toss impact, and venue and season patterns.

projects.name: AutoElite
highlights: Built a responsive car dealership site with real-time search, multi-criteria filtering, sorting, and a favorites shortlist over a structured JS dataset.
Wrote event-driven JavaScript for dynamic card rendering and a modal login flow, keeping markup, styling, and logic in separate files.
